# Technical Ustad

> > Technical Ustad provides practical guides, tutorials, and reviews covering Windows optimization, networking infrastructure, gaming performance, productivity tools, and consumer technology.

The site focuses on technical how-to guides for Windows 10/11 system configuration, enterprise networking solutions (F5 BIG-IP, Check Point), gaming optimization, and product reviews for hardware and software across platforms including Android, iOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi.

## Key Topics

- Windows 10 optimization
- F5 BIG-IP configuration
- Gaming performance tuning
- Registry editing
- Network troubleshooting
- Check Point Gaia
- Speech recognition
- Chrome Flags
- Exchange Server hybrid deployments
- System requirements checking
- Privacy settings
- Educational technology
- Arduino and Raspberry Pi
- WordPress
- Python

- [How to install checkpoint gaia on vmware ( Step-by-Step )](https://technicalustad.com/how-to-install-checkpoint-gaia-on-vmware): Step-by-step Check Point Gaia installation guide for VMware
